metadata.verticalCoordinate: Uses level_z_value as returned by WFS (meters); vertical datum is not identified in the feature response.
metadata.estimatedProfile: CSDI platform elevations are assigned to route directions when platform amenity names identify their destination. Distinct platform levels without a direction match are left unassigned rather than averaged. Track heights between directional station anchors use length-weighted harmonic interpolation; no artificial tunnel sag is applied. This remains an estimated rail profile, not surveyed track alignment data.
